notes.notes: [p]Our app will be leaving Steam Store 7-22-2025 to prepare for the Early Access release of the album which will release the same day. The new app below will replace the EP and have more songs and videos. Everyone who purchased this app will still have access to it and all songs included. Thank you everyone for supporting our project! [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531200/Forever_Epic_Story_A_Journey_of_Life_Music_Album/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
